# hyperlite_role (Resource)

A custom role: a set of privileges (`vm.power`, `vm.allocate`, `storage.allocate`...), given by `hyperlite_acl`. A change of privileges keeps its assignments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What a deployment pipeline needs to create VMs in a pool, without being an administrator.
resource "hyperlite_role" "deployer" {
  name       = "deployer"
  privileges = ["vm.allocate", "vm.power", "vm.hardware", "storage.allocate", "network.assign"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Its name.
- `privileges` (Set of String) Its privileges (Hyperlite's GET /api/v1/acl/privileges lists them).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The role's id.
- `key` (String) What `hyperlite_acl.role` takes: `custom:<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id.
terraform import hyperlite_role.deployer 4
```
